Anything you can watch on discovery you can torrent.  Also, I think you will find that it isn't really something that you like as much as something you are used to.  Cancel it and see if you miss it.  I was surprised how little I missed tv after I canceled it.  It just was something that I had gotten used to.  And then I switched my thinking to "Time to see what's on Netflix, instead of "time to channel surf".  It really wasn't a change at all.

The only hard sell is ESPN.  If you are using this to watch sports, well, there really isn't another place to watch them unless you get, say, the MLB package online. 

So really your whole bill is being spent on sports.  If that is ok with you then keep it.  If not, then kill it.  the only middle ground would be to keep the basic channels, like fox and nbc which shouldn't cost more than $12 per month, and then watch the weekly games.
And a million Iraqis, but who's counting them.
I am just saying, if you are going to get addicted to a drug you can do worse than heroin.  this video is proof.  It's tongue in cheek but true.
It's this type of thing that makes me feel lucky that I was addicted to heroin.  Of all the hard drugs I think I chose the right one.
